scope: Fang lightweight native-baseline deployment composition; no gameplay/live state

mechanism_facts.fact: Fang talent prefab1 uniquely binds by exact properties hash to current MonoScript DeckTalentToAddCardCost; selector onlySelectMe=1.
AssignData cost literal from current metadata; Blackboard.GetIntOrDefault -> m_cost+0x80.
CreateDeckModifier transfers integer m_cost to modifier+0x50. Virtual slot15 selects TryGetCardCostDelta; DeckSelector.Verify onlySelectMe tests sourceCard identity.
Card.UpdateDeckAttributeData callback preprocesses runes, constructs snapshot, calls _PreprocessCharCost. Slot15 delta is added to snapshot integer cost then ModifyCost/OverwriteRawData(COST=4).
Card.get_rawCost reads modified snapshot, scales redeployment and floors. Card.get_cost applies runtime scale floor then integer runtime delta; fixed limits preserved.
Relic final attributes writer is FP.AsFloat then ObscuredInt ties-to-even; current float round exact half checks integer parity. FP Floor/Multiply and runtime floor independently mapped.

mechanism_limitations: Current XLua/hotfix branches retained; current equivalence unknown.
No actual card consumption/deployment/game actions inferred.
Only Fang prefab1 is source-qualified; a cost key on another talent stays unknown.
Explicit pure redeploy/card-factor oracle does not imply those conditions were sampled.
